privacy.visibilityDesc: Who fit open your full profile — your activity, your climb and your stats. Public: anybody wey dey Shape. Only friends: na only members wey una dey share chat. Private: e go hide, so people go just see your name and your tier.

privacy.onlineDesc: When e on, one live dot go show for your avatar so people go sabi say you dey active for the app now. Off am make you fit browse quiet-quiet — dem no go ever show say you dey around.
privacy.shareWorkoutDesc: When e on, the workout wey you log, your PRs and your activity fit show for your profile and for the community feed. Off go make your training show only for you and the coach wey you connect.
privacy.agePublic: Show my age for my profile
privacy.agePublicDesc: E dey off by default. If you put am on, na your age — no be the day wey you born — go show for your profile. Your coach dem go always see the age of the clients wey dem dey work with, because e dey change how dem dey plan for you.

integrations.intro: Connect health, activity, and music platforms. Workout wey WHOOP import dey private first, den you go choose wetin coaches or di community feed go see.
integrations.loadError: We no fit load di integrations.
integrations.noteAppleHealthNative: Read your steps, heart rate, HRV, resting HR, sleep, active energy, and workouts from Apple Health (Apple Watch too) go inside your daily snapshot.
integrations.noteAppleHealthWeb: Apple Health (and Apple Watch) data dey only for di Shape iOS app. Open Shape for your iPhone make you connect am.
integrations.noteAppleMusic: Authorize Apple Music with MusicKit make your library fit give you workout playlist. Na here you dey give di access — no redirect.
integrations.noteGarmin: Pull Garmin Connect activities, heart rate, and sleep enter your profile. E need Garmin Health API approval for di developer account.
integrations.noteInstacart: Send di grocery list wey your coach build go Instacart make e open cart wey don full already. While Instacart access still dey wait, we go copy di list go your clipboard instead.
integrations.noteOura: Sync Oura Ring sleep, readiness, and heart-rate data enter your daily health snapshot. Workouts dey import private, like WHOOP.
integrations.noteSpotify: Pick workout playlist from your Spotify library make you attach am to program. E dey stream for Shape Radio and for di workout player.
integrations.noteStrava: Connect Strava activities and map data. Route import go use di same private-first sharing style like WHOOP.
integrations.noteWhoop: Sync recovery, sleep, body measurements, cycles, and workouts. Workout wey you import dey private until you share am.
